sources: https://www.lacrossecounty.org/facilities/campgrounds (La Crosse County campgrounds page, read live with the headless browser, desktop Chrome UA, 2026-11-20): 'Veterans Memorial Campground / Make a Reservation / Online: Browse Availability / By Phone: (608) 789-8599 ... located on Hwy. 16, 9 miles East of La Crosse or 1 mile West of West Salem. We are located on the La Crosse River and also provide access to the La Crosse River State Bike Trail'; N4668 County Road VP, West Salem; GPS 43.891232,-91.116408; 'Campground Season: April 15th to October 15th'.

https://www.lacrossecounty.org/docs/default-source/facilities/services_scheduleoffees.pdf (La Crosse County Facilities Dept '2026 Schedule of Fees', downloaded through the headless browser 2026-11-20): VETERANS MEMORIAL CAMPGROUND RATES - Nightly: No Hookups $23.00, Electric 20 amp $32.00, Electric 30 amp $34.00, Water/Electric 50 amp $38.00, plus tax; Sr. nightly $0.50 less; Monthly (28 day) $650/$670/$695; Seasonal (April 15 to Oct 15) $2,148.85/$2,332.00/$2,442.00; Shower fee 4 minutes $0.25.

https://www.lacrossecounty.org/docs/default-source/facilities/veterans-parent-map.pdf (Veterans Memorial Campground layout map, downloaded through the headless browser 2026-11-20): 'OPEN APRIL 15TH THROUGH OCTOBER 15'; features 'LAUNDRY, CAMP STORE, CANOE LANDING, PLAYGROUND, BIKE TRAIL ACCESS, WEEKEND ACTIVITIES, DUMP STATION, HORSESHOES, FIREWOOD, FISHING POND, CLEAN MODERN RESTROOMS, ELECTRICAL & WATER HOOKUPS'; legend 20A/30A/50A electric and electric & water sites plus rustic sites; sites 101-143 in the SW loop by the river (rustic 139-143 along the bank), 201-254 and 300-342 in the east loops (rustic 201-209 along the river east of the canoe landing); ~120 numbered sites; rules 'Campers must register before setting up', 'Two vehicles per site if room'.

https://webtrac.lacrossecounty.org/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN&primarycode=Veterans+Memorial (county WebTrac, read live with the headless browser 2026-11-20; page 1 of 92 rental items only - paging triggered a Cloudflare block, not pursued): 'Reservations begin on January 4th, 2027 and We open for camping on Tuesday April 15th, 2027 at 10 a.m. ... Campsites are available April 15th through October 15th. Reservations can be made online for up to 7 days. Longer stays must be done through our campground office. For Longterm/Monthly stays, please email the Facilities Department ... (608-789-8599)'; 'Check In time is 3 p.m. and Check Out time is 1 p.m.'; 'Standard fee is for TWO camping units (two tents or an RV and one tent on a campsite)'; 'HOLIDAY Reservations (Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day) require a minimum of three nights if the holiday falls on Friday, Saturday, Sunday or Monday.'; 'Showers are coin operated.'; sites 101-123 (50A W) 'Max Unit Length' 26-40 ft.

Esri World Imagery (tools/sat.py, 2026-11-20, leaf-off) at 43.8925,-91.1170 (520 m) and 43.8918,-91.1182 (220 m): campground loops south of the ball diamonds, wrapped by the La Crosse River on the W and S; channel ~27-32 m wide; tables along the south bank ~15-30 m from the water over mown grass with scattered trees; the SW loop's west side sits behind a fringe of bank trees.
